about: Inputs from the platform's parity fixture (src/lib/engines/__tests__/fixtures/python-parity.json) plus one year-guard case; expected is the exact output of run(inputs). The platform's parity test checks these outputs against the Python reference engines of the 6 Nov 2026 A/B test (Malta: against an independent Python reference, mt-income-tax.test.ts).

headline.label: Income tax + Medicare levy 2026-27 (take-home in lines)

steps: Standard work deduction top-up = max(0, min(AUD 1,000.00, labour income AUD 100,000.00) less work expenses AUD 0.00) = AUD 1,000.00; work deductions = AUD 1,000.00
Taxable income = AUD 100,000.00 less other deductions AUD 0.00 less work deductions AUD 1,000.00 = AUD 99,000.00
Tax on taxable income at the 2026-27 resident rates = AUD 20,220.00
Low income tax offset = AUD 0.00; income tax after offsets = AUD 20,220.00
Medicare levy 2% of taxable income = AUD 1,980.00; no surcharge (private hospital cover)
Income tax + Medicare = AUD 22,200.00; take-home = AUD 77,800.00

constants_used.name: LITO
constants_used.section: Individual income tax / Offsets and deductions
constants_used.quote: LITO | $700 to $37,500; taper 5c/$1 to $45,000; then 1.5c/$1 to nil at $66,667

constants_used.name: MEDICARE_LEVY_RATE
constants_used.quote: Levy | 2% of taxable income

constants_used.name: MEDICARE_LOW_INCOME_SINGLE_2026_27
constants_used.quote: 2026-27 Medicare levy. The current Act sets the single non-SAPTO threshold at $28,011, with phase-in up to $35,013.

constants_used.name: MLS_BASE_TIER_SINGLE
constants_used.quote: MLS base tier | Single $101,000 / family $202,000 (then 1% / 1.25% / 1.5%)

constants_used.name: STANDARD_WRE_DEDUCTION
constants_used.section: Individual income tax / Offsets and deductions
constants_used.quote: $1,000 standard WRE deduction | From 2026-27, an individual resident at any time in the year with qualifying assessable labour income can receive a top-up: max(0, min($1,000, that labour income) minus specified labour-related deductions). Business/PSI income alone does not qualify

assumptions: Resident for the full year
No Medicare levy reduction (income above the low-income range)
Take-home = gross income less income tax and Medicare levy (super is on top of salary)

Standard work deduction: a top-up to the smaller of $1,000 and labour income, less the work expenses claimed (au-rates-2026-27); the work expenses claimed are taken as the specified labour-related deductions
Labour income taken as equal to gross income; give labour_income if part of gross income is business or PSI income
